methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $2M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
ADMARES is a seed-stage company in Housing & Construction founded by Mikael Hedberg. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of five private companies operating in the same sector—BotBuilt, Apis Cor, Unlimited Industries, Ground Control Development, and Hedral—with no public comparables available for direct benchmarking.

The stage-progression method was the applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised of $1.78M as a proxy baseline value of approximately $2M, a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $4.5M. This reflects the expected increase in company value between funding rounds before material operational or revenue milestones are achieved.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $4M to $5M, with a median point of $4M. Given the single-method triangulation and the absence of public market data, key uncertainties center on the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific subsector and the representativeness of the private peer set. Additional substantive inputs—including revenue run rate, customer traction, or capital efficiency metrics relative to the comparable universe—would strengthen conviction in this range.
